# ShyOS Configuration

`config/shyos.mk` is the complete final-image configuration template. It is
not loaded globally. Every app, kernel, and test project owns a copied
`shyos.mk` next to its Makefile:

```text
app/2048/shyos.mk
kernel/shyos.mk
test/test06_basic_c/shyos.mk
```

Each image Makefile sets `SHYOS_CONFIG` to that local file before including
`mk/config.mk`. The local configuration directly lists the macros enabled for
that image and selects its highest linked layer with `IMAGE_LAYER`.

The same file selects the build mode:

```make
# CONFIG=DEBUG
CONFIG=RELEASE
```

`DEBUG` uses `-O0 -g3` for C and Cargo's dev profile. `RELEASE` uses `-O2`
for C and Cargo's release profile. Changing `CONFIG` updates the shared
configuration marker, so the current module objects and layer archives are
rebuilt for the selected mode.

For example, the default QEMU backend is:

```make
SHYOS_DEFINES += SHYOS_BACKEND_QEMU_VIRT
SHYOS_DEFINES += BOARD_QEMU_VIRT

# SHYOS_DEFINES += SHYOS_BACKEND_LINUX_USER
```

To select Linux user mode, comment out the two QEMU lines and uncomment the
Linux line:

```make
# SHYOS_DEFINES += SHYOS_BACKEND_QEMU_VIRT
# SHYOS_DEFINES += BOARD_QEMU_VIRT

SHYOS_DEFINES += SHYOS_BACKEND_LINUX_USER
```

Every active word in `SHYOS_DEFINES` is forwarded unchanged:

```make
SHYOS_DEFINES += SHYOS_ALLOCATOR_BUDDY
```

becomes:

```c
#if defined(SHYOS_ALLOCATOR_BUDDY)
#endif
```

and:

```rust
#[cfg(SHYOS_ALLOCATOR_BUDDY)]
fn allocator_impl() {}
```

Adding ordinary allocator, scheduler, or feature macros does not require a
second mapping table. A new backend still needs build logic because it may
change the compiler target, startup objects, and linker behavior.

The final layer is selected in the same local file:

```make
IMAGE_LAYER := 04data_structure
```

## Capability providers

公共能力使用独立共享模块表达，例如 `lib/alloc` 是 allocator ABI 节点。消费者依赖
能力接口，而不是具体实现：

```text
string -> alloc
vec -> alloc
simple_alloc -> alloc
```

provider 在自己的 `Cargo.toml` 中声明能力与选择宏：

```toml
[[package.metadata.shyos.provides]]
capability = "alloc"
define = "SHYOS_ALLOCATOR_SIMPLE"
```

`make dag-html` 会读取当前选中 app 的 `shyos.mk`，列出所有 provider，并标记当前配置
选中的实现。

`00arch/uart` 是 raw UART capability 节点，配置必须选择恰好一个
`SHYOS_UART_*` provider：

- `SHYOS_UART_POLLING`（`00arch/uart`）：正式 stdio 使用轮询 UART
- `SHYOS_UART_INTERRUPT`（`02core/uart_interupt`）：正式 stdio 使用中断驱动
  UART；使用前需调用 `uart_interupt_init`

`01log/print` 统一实现正式 stdio 的格式化与扫描逻辑，最终调用所选 provider 的
`raw_putc` / `raw_getc`。`early_stdio.h`、`early_*` C 符号以及 Rust 的
`early_print!`、`early_println!` 固定调用始终存在的 `early_raw_putc` /
`early_raw_getc` 轮询通道，不受 provider 选择影响。

## Allocator arena (board defines)

`SHYOS_ALLOCATOR_SIMPLE` 的 heap 区间不在 `shyos.mk` 里写死，而在对应 board：

| backend | header | macros |
|---|---|---|
| QEMU virt | `lib/board/qemu_virt/qemu.h` | `RAM_BASE`, `RAM_SIZE`, `HEAP_START`, `HEAP_SIZE` |
| Linux user | `lib/board/linux_user/linux_user.h` | `HEAP_START=NULL`, `HEAP_SIZE` |

约定：

```text
HEAP_START != NULL  -> 使用给定线性区 [HEAP_START, HEAP_START+HEAP_SIZE)
HEAP_START == NULL  -> simple_alloc 自行向宿主申请 HEAP_SIZE 字节 arena
```

QEMU 默认：

```text
RAM_BASE   = 0x80000000
RAM_SIZE   = 256 MiB
HEAP_START = RAM_BASE + 64 MiB
HEAP_SIZE  = RAM_SIZE - 64 MiB   # 192 MiB，保证不越出 256 MiB
```

`make run-app` / `run-kernel` 使用 `-m 256M`（可用 `QEMU_MEM=` 覆盖）。

Linux user 默认：

```text
HEAP_START = NULL
HEAP_SIZE  = 196 MiB
```

An alternate configuration file can still be selected when invoking an image
project directly:

```sh
make -C app/2048 SHYOS_CONFIG=/path/to/shyos.mk
```

New mixed C/Rust app projects are created from the same complete template:

```sh
python3 tools/new_app.py --root . app/example
# or
make new-app APP=app/example
```

## Rust toolchain

ShyOS uses the nightly Rust toolchain with the `rust-src` and
`rust-analyzer` components. Final Rust image crates are built as `staticlib`
with:

```text
-Z build-std=core,alloc,compiler_builtins
```

This rebuilds the `no_std` runtime closure for the selected target. In
particular, Linux user images must not reuse hosted prebuilt `core`/`alloc`
artifacts that assume `libstd` will provide unwind runtime symbols.

Layer facade crates remain `rlib` dependencies. Every image layer also has a
small `rust_image` staticlib crate for C-only images. It packages that layer's
complete Rust dependency closure into:

```text
libshyos_<layer>_rust.a
```

All Cargo invocations share `target/cargo` and the same target, profile,
`RUSTFLAGS`, and build-std settings, so app and layer staticlibs reuse the
same compiled dependency crates.

C-only images link `<layer>.layer.ld`, which contains the C/assembly layer
archives and the selected highest layer's Rust staticlib. Images that define
`IMAGE_RUST_STATICLIB` link `<layer>.norust.layer.ld`; their own staticlib
already contains the same Rust closure.
